message: text:我會使用 execute skill，先讀本地指引與指定 inbox 輸入，再用目前的 owner 檢查原始 checkpoint；不會向 GitHub 傳送 fixture 請求。
$ pwd; cat .agents/skills/execute/SKILL.md; cat AGENTS.md; printenv NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR
$ git status --short; git show --stat --oneline HEAD; python3 -B ./soodles.py landing --help

$ python3 -B -c 'import os,pathlib,hashlib; d=pathlib.Path(os.environ[\"NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR\"]).parent/\"inbox\"; names=[\"identity-input.json\",\"runtime-readback.json\",\"checkpoint.json\",\"provider.json\",\"historical-seed.json\"]; [(print(\"FILE\", n),print((d/n).read_text()),print(\"SHA256\",hashlib.sha256((d/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest())) for n in names]; print({k:os.environ.get(k) for k in [\"NOODLE_SESSION_ID\",\"NOODLE_ORDER_ID\",\"NOODLE_STAGE_INDEX\"]})
$ python3 -B ./soodles.py landing advance --help; python3 -B ./soodles.py landing dispatch --help; python3 -B ./soodles.py landing resume --help
text:fixture 顯示 merge 已標記為 `offered`，但目前 provider 快照仍是 PR 開啟、未合併。歷史備註要求重送 merge，這不足以授權重送；我會呼叫目前 owner，確認它回傳的下一步及 checkpoint 是否保持不變。
$ sed -n '1,115p' landing.py; sed -n '150,210p' landing.py; sed -n '405,481p' landing.py; rg -n 'offered|no.*repeat|dispatch|merge_pending' tests/test_landing.py

$ sed -n '45,72p' tests/test_landing.py; sed -n '584,607p' tests/test_landing.py; python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, hashlib, subprocess
inbox = pathlib.Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent / 'inbox'
checkpoint = inbox / 'checkpoint.json'
before = hashlib.sha256(checkpoint.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print('checkpoint:', checkpoint, flush=True)
print('sha256_before:', before, flush=True)
result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', './soodles.py', 'landing', 'dispatch', str(checkpoint), str(inbox / 'provider.json')], text=True, capture_output=True)
print('exit_code:', result.returncode)
print('stdout:', result.stdout)
print('stderr:', result.stderr)
after = hashlib.sha256(checkpoint.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
print('sha256_after:', after)
print('unchanged:', before == after)
PY
